title: Base-change comparison of the two explicitly transported projection traces
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, N A=0, t normalized twist transport [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows], and d a family of arbitrary-base P1 splittings satisfying ArbitraryBaseFiniteP1BaseChange [lem-sp-tower-p1-arbitrary-base-integrals]. Let f:X -> S be proper and i:X ≅ ProjectiveLine(S) over S, with N invertible on S. For either projection a, use the explicit maps of [def-sf-p1-integral-transport-data]. Then middleComparison_a followed by Li* of arbitraryBaseFiniteP1DiagonalTrace_a and constantComparison equals coordinateTrace_a of the explicitly constructed trace associated with (d S).trace. This equation is only about the trace arrows; it has no supported Ext representative and asserts no integral identity.

source.place: The paragraphs identifying t_p1 and t_p2 with base change of t_q, using qp1=qp2 and the composite-adjunction counit.

proof.text: Apply the trace clause of hbc to q:ProjectiveLine(S) → S. This is the concrete equation q*(d S).trace followed by the constant comparison equals the projective-space exchange and line comparison followed by (d P).trace.

Factor the chart map as projectionExchange followed by the projective-space exchange and line comparison using chartExchange. Postcompose with (d P).trace and substitute the preceding equation. Associativity gives the chart trace as inverse product exchange followed by pullback of (d S).trace and its constant-object comparison.

Apply Li* to this equality and preserve composition. Precompose with middleComparison and append constantComparison. The arbitrary-arrow equation projectionTraceTransport, instantiated at τ=(d S).trace, identifies the resulting composite with coordinateTrace.

proof_origin.place: Trace base-change paragraph; chart factorization followed by naturality under the presentation isomorphism, implemented by U4.

lean.statement:
theorem traceComparison
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (N : ℕ) (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    (d : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (hT : IsUnit (N : Γ(T, ⊤))),
      ArbitraryBaseFiniteP1Splitting A N hA t T hT)
    (hbc : ArbitraryBaseFiniteP1BaseChange A N hA t d)
    {S X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsProper f]
    (i : X ≅ ProjectiveLine S) (hi : i.hom ≫ (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) = f)
    (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))) (a : Bool) :
    middleComparison A N hA t f i hi hS a ≫
        (ordinaryFinitePullback A i.hom).map
          (arbitraryBaseFiniteP1DiagonalTrace A N hA t d S hS a) ≫
        (constantComparison A i).hom =
      coordinateTrace A N hA t f i hi hS (d S hS).trace a
